messages.author: a71c8cca22ce9c0c
messages.subject: scale of GEV  shape parameter 'xi'
parts:
I understand that the GEV shape parameter 'xi' is used internally with a scale 'gev.scale.xi' defaulting to 0.01. However when I sample the hyperparams for a model with "gev" family, I guess that the simulated value is rather 0.1 * xi. This seems to be true whatever be the value of 'scale' passed to 'inla'.

Best

rgev <-  function(n = 1, xi = 0, mu = 0.0, sd = 1.0) {
    u <- runif(n)
    if (xi == 0) x <- -log(-log(u))
    else x = ((-log(u))^(-xi) - 1.0) / xi
    x * sd + mu
}
n <- 300; set.seed(12)
z <- rnorm(n)
sd.y <- 0.1
xi <- 0.1
y <- 1 + z + rgev(n, xi = xi, sd = sd.y)
r <- inla(y ~ 1 + z, data = data.frame(y, z),
          family = "gev")
myPost <- inla.hyperpar.sample(n = 3000, result = r)
c("sampled" = sd(myPost[ , 2]),
  "summary" = r$summary.hyperpar["tail", "sd"])

There is a better implementation and formulation of that model now, see

inla.doc("bgev")

and there is a vignette as well; see

browserVignettes(package="INLA")


H
